response.description:
ExpressRoute Scalable Gateway (ErGwScale) is our
next-generation offering that brings flexibility, performance, and operational
simplicity to Virtual Network Gateway deployments. With this release, you can
dynamically scale gateway infrastructure to meet real-time traffic demands. What’s new 
 Dynamic scaling: Deploy ErGwScale to achieve
     up to 40 Gbps of connectivity for virtual machines and private
     endpoints within your virtual network. 
 Auto scaling: Configure minimum and maximum
     scale units, and Azure automatically adjusts capacity based on bandwidth
     and flow demand—delivering efficiency and eliminating manual tuning. 
 Fixed scale option: For predictable workloads,
     set a steady scale to maintain consistent bandwidth for stable traffic
     patterns. 
 FastPath + gateway coexistence: ErGwScale
     complements FastPath for scenarios where FastPath isn’t supported—such as
     high-bandwidth or complex routing cases—ensuring seamless performance. This offering introduces elastic
scaling, zero-downtime upgrades, and enterprise-grade reliability, making
it ideal for hybrid connectivity and demanding workloads.  Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: ExpressRoute Scalable Gateway
